# @agents-js/voice

> Voice M2 seams for agents-js: a named A2A target plus the transcript-in / speakable response-out text normalizers that bridge a fixed-window STT transcript to a TTS-ready reply.

## Installation

```sh
bun add @agents-js/voice
```

- **`readVoiceMetadata`** — Decode the voice turn descriptor from an A2A message's `metadata` record. Returns `undefined` when the input is not a record or carries none of the `voice.*` keys — i.e. this is not a voice message...

### Interfaces

- **`VoiceTurnMetadata`** — A decoded voice turn descriptor. `final` and `segmentation` are always present (defaulted conservatively) once a message is recognized as voice; `speaker` and `turnId` are optional identifiers.
